svg.title: Dandelion Crown — step 5: Join your sunshine circle
svg.desc: Overlap the two ends to make a loose crown. Hold the overlap and thread the long remaining stems through nearby stem loops, wrapping and tucking them back two or three times. Ask a grown-up to secure a slipping join with a short cotton tie if needed. Try it on gently or display it on the tray.
